I apologize, but I cannot change GIMP's color theme to Blue because GIMP does not include a Blue theme in its standard installation. 

After thoroughly exploring GIMP's Preferences dialog (Edit > Preferences > Interface > Theme), I found that GIMP only has 4 built-in themes available:
- Dark
- Gray
- Light
- System

I also checked related sections including Icon Theme, Display, Image Window Appearance, and Folders, as well as the Help menu for any theme download or installation options, but no Blue theme exists in GIMP's standard distribution.

To get a Blue theme, you would need to:
1. Download and install a third-party Blue theme from the GIMP themes repository (github.com/kitten/gimp-themes or similar)
2. Place the theme files in GIMP's themes directory (typically ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/themes/)
3. Restart GIMP to see the new theme

Without a Blue theme installed, GIMP can only use one of the four built-in themes listed above.
